name: Being Obedient
overview: Scripture teaches that obedience is a vital expression of love and righteousness, as seen in John 14:15 where keeping Christ's commandments is linked to loving Him. The obedience of one, Christ, brings righteousness to many, contrasting the consequences of disobedience in Romans 5:19. Children are specifically called to obey their parents as a matter of right in Ephesians 6:1, reflecting the broader principle of submitting to those who lead with care for our souls, as instructed in Hebrews 13:17. True blessing comes to those who hear and keep God's word, emphasizing that obedience is not merely external compliance but a heartfelt response to God's authority (Luke 11:28).
